headline: Projects in Community Preservation Committee Rounds 12, 13, and 14, including Balch Playground, Holcroft Park splashpad, and Gillis Park pavilion.
summary: The meeting covers park and recreation project updates. These include Community Preservation Committee Rounds 12 through 14. Staff will also report on classes, events, and budgets.
items: Assistant Director's report: past months' summary and upcoming classes and events
Director's report: recent and upcoming events, correspondence, and general budget and enterprise fund updates
Round 12 project updates: Balch Playground Phase 2 (Cummings Donation), Holcroft Park Splashpad update, and Gillis Park Pavilion
Round 13 applications for Ahearn Park, Bartlett Gardens, and Gillis Basketball: ordering equipment and bids for court replacements
Round 14 applications for Obear Park, Cooney Field, and McPherson Youth Center: all deemed eligible to submit full applications
Other projects: Abbott St. ROW and Independence Park
Ongoing projects: Gillis Park Entrance, AED's, Beverly in Bloom, Lynch Park Resiliency, and other park improvements and repairs
Commission reports: Beverly Golf & Tennis Commission (Bill Lowd), Community Preservation Committee (Nancy Marino), and Open Space & Recreation Committee (Mario Tricomi)
location: Beverly Senior Center (90 Colon Street, Beverly)
